segments.name: Air transportation
segments.description: Ultra low-cost carrier flying leisure passengers across the United States and select international destinations in the Americas, selling low fares with optional and bundled services.
segments.evidence: The Company is managed as a single business unit that provides air transportation for passengers and management has concluded there is only one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Leisure passengers pay base fares plus fees for optional services such as baggage, seat selection and bundled packages, while partners pay for the co-brand credit card and loyalty programs.
revenueModel.evidence: We combine our low fares with flexible optional services for an additional cost.
